food_plant.name: Plant food
food_plant.hint: A phytosanitary certificate is required. Imports into the EU also need a CHED-PP pre-notification in TRACES NT.

food_animal.name: Animal food
food_animal.hint: A veterinary certificate is required, plus an establishment approved in the destination country (USDA FSIS, GACC, TRACES).

food_processed.name: Processed food
food_processed.hint: A certificate of analysis and compliant labelling are usually enough. Shipments to the USA also need an FDA Prior Notice.

beverages.name: Drinks and alcohol
beverages.hint: Alcohol needs an import licence and excise duty. Spirits are also ADR class 3.

electronics.name: Electronics
electronics.hint: CE declaration (EU), FCC (USA), CCC (China). Lithium batteries bring transport restrictions.

machinery.name: Machinery and equipment
machinery.hint: CE declaration under the Machinery Directive. Out of gauge loads need special transport permits.

chemicals.name: Industrial chemicals
chemicals.hint: Safety data sheet (MSDS/SDS), ADR/IMDG papers and REACH registration when placing goods on the EU market.

chemicals_cons.name: Consumer chemicals
chemicals_cons.hint: Safety data sheet and REACH/SVHC. Aerosols and flammable products fall under ADR.

medicines.name: Medicines and pharmaceuticals
medicines.hint: GMP certificate, batch release and marketing authorisation. Usually a GDP cold chain as well.

cosmetics.name: Cosmetics
cosmetics.hint: Safety report (EU) and Free Sale Certificate. China requires NMPA registration. Perfume is ADR class 3.

textiles.name: Clothing and textiles
textiles.hint: Fibre composition label and REACH/SVHC. For cotton from China, check UFLPA before exporting to the USA.

vehicles.name: Vehicles
vehicles.hint: Certificate of conformity (CoC), type approval and emissions certificate. Used vehicles face age limits.

metals.name: Metals and raw materials
metals.hint: Mill certificate and weight certificate. Check anti-dumping duties.

wood.name: Wood and wood products
wood.hint: FLEGT (legal harvesting), ISPM15 for wooden packaging, CITES for protected species.

medical.name: Medical and optical devices
medical.hint: CE marking under MDR/IVDR and a notified body certificate. For the USA, FDA 510(k) or PMA.

energy.name: Energy and fuels
energy.hint: Fuels are ADR/IMDG class 2 or 3 with excise duty. For raw materials, check the sanctions lists.

construction.name: Construction materials
construction.hint: Quality certificate and declaration of performance. Dusty materials need an MSDS.

luxury.name: Luxury and special goods
luxury.hint: The customs value must be exact. Insurance is required, and often CITES or a cultural goods export permit.

defence.name: Controlled and defence goods
defence.hint: Export licence and End User Certificate. Check UN, EU and US embargoes before signing the contract.

subcategories.mdc002: Class IIa medical devices (blood pressure monitors)

warnings.fp010: USA: a citrus canker freedom certificate is required.
warnings.fp023: An aflatoxin certificate is required. Limits are very strict in the EU and Japan.
warnings.fp026: Australia: tomatoes from many countries are banned. Check BICON.
warnings.fp027: Australia: fresh potatoes are BANNED. USA: approved countries only.
warnings.fp029: China is the main exporter. Check anti-dumping duties when importing into the EU.
warnings.fp038: Check the mycotoxin limits (DON, aflatoxins) for the destination country.
warnings.fp039: GMO risk: the EU, Japan and Australia require a non-GMO certificate.
warnings.fp041: Soya carries the highest GMO risk. The EU requires labelling above 0.9% GMO.
warnings.fp050: RSPO (sustainable palm oil) is increasingly required by EU buyers.
warnings.fp052: Check whether the species is on the CITES list, for example mahogany or rosewood.
warnings.fp054: Importing tobacco requires special licences in most countries.
warnings.fa001: USA: the establishment must be approved by USDA FSIS. China: GACC registration.
warnings.fa003: Pork imports are banned in Muslim countries (SA, AE, MY, ID and others).
warnings.fa004: Imports are banned in Muslim countries.
warnings.fa008: The horse must have a passport. Many countries do not accept horse meat.
warnings.fa013: USA: SIMP catch documentation is required for tuna.
warnings.fa015: A marine biotoxin freedom certificate is required.
warnings.fa017: USA: the establishment must be registered with the FDA.
warnings.fa020: China: GACC establishment registration is required.
warnings.fa021: USA: raw milk cheese carries specific FDA requirements (minimum 60 days ageing).
warnings.fa022: A salmonella freedom certificate is required.
warnings.fa023: An antibiotic residue freedom certificate is required.
warnings.pr014: USA: FDA registration is required. AU: a DAFF permit for meat products.
warnings.pr015: Classification differs by country: EU as a supplement, USA as a dietary supplement, elsewhere as a medicine. Check before shipping.
warnings.bv004: Some ingredients (taurine, high dose caffeine) are banned in certain countries.
warnings.bv005: USA: a TTB COLA is required. Importers must be licensed, state by state.
warnings.bv006: Saudi Arabia, Kuwait and Qatar: alcohol imports are BANNED.
warnings.bv008: Champagne: only from the Champagne region of France, protected designation.
warnings.bv009: Transport: ADR class 3 (UN1170, ethyl alcohol). Saudi Arabia: BANNED.
warnings.bv010: Scotch whisky: Scotland only. Bourbon: USA only. Both are protected designations.
warnings.bv013: Cognac: only from the Cognac region of France.
warnings.el001: Lithium batteries bring air freight restrictions. CE marking is mandatory for the EU.
warnings.el003: Battery state of charge is capped at 30% for bulk air shipments.
warnings.el005: Advanced servers may need a dual-use licence for export to certain countries.
warnings.el006: EU: an energy label and EPREL registration are mandatory.
warnings.el011: Devices with Bluetooth or LTE are classified as communication equipment (8517.62), not watches. Simple bands and watches without connectivity may fall under 9102 or 9031.
warnings.el012: Network devices may need a telecom approval in the importing country.
warnings.el013: UN3480 (standalone batteries) carries air freight restrictions and many airlines refuse them.
warnings.el014: EU: check anti-dumping duties on panels from China.
warnings.el015: EU: an F-gas certificate is required for equipment containing refrigerant.
warnings.el022: Drones may need an aviation permit in the importing country. Check EASA and FAA rules.
warnings.mach001: Precision CNC lathes may need a dual-use licence (missile and weapons production).
warnings.mach003: High pressure compressors may be dual-use.
warnings.mach005: Turbine blades run up to 70 m. Special transport with road permits in every transit country.
warnings.mach006: With fuel in the tank, air freight is banned. Drain and purge the tank.
warnings.mach007: Chemical reactors may be dual-use (chemical substance production).
warnings.ch001: ADR class 8 (corrosive). UN1830. Special vehicles and containers.
warnings.ch002: A drug precursor. Registration is required in the EU.
warnings.ch003: Dual-use: can be used to make explosives.
warnings.ch004: UN1823 is the solid form, UN1824 the solution. Class 8.
warnings.ch005: UN1090, ADR class 3. A drug precursor, registration required.
warnings.ch006: UN1170, ADR class 3. May require denaturing and special permits.
warnings.ch007: A drug precursor and dual-use. ADR class 3.
warnings.ch008: UN1005, ADR class 2. Toxic. Can be used to make explosives.
warnings.ch009: CWC chemical weapon, Schedule 3. A dual-use export licence is required.
warnings.ch010: Above 16% nitrogen it can be an explosive. EU control under Regulation 2019/1148.
warnings.ch012: Glyphosate is contentious in the EU. Check the current authorisations.
warnings.ch013: Check the Rotterdam Convention. Some substances need Prior Informed Consent (PIC).
warnings.ch014: Check the VOC content. The EU and USA both set limits.
warnings.ch017: The cylinder must hold a valid pressure test. Cryogenic liquids follow special rules.
warnings.cc001: EU: surfactant biodegradability information is mandatory.
warnings.cc002: If they contain a biocide, BPR registration is required in the EU.
warnings.cc003: EU: VOC limits under Directive 2004/42/EC. Lead and chromium free, with a certificate.
warnings.cc005: The API service classification must appear on the label.
warnings.cc007: Aerosol: ADR class 2. Biocide: BPR registration. Some substances are banned in the EU.
warnings.med001: USA: FDA NDA/ANDA. China: NMPA. India: CDSCO. Brazil: ANVISA.
warnings.med003: The 2 to 8°C cold chain is absolutely critical. Any excursion destroys the batch.
warnings.med004: A Drug Master File (DMF) is required by the FDA and other authorities.
warnings.med005: Classification differs by country. USA: dietary supplement (FDA). EU: food supplement. Japan: FoSHU.
warnings.med006: Two licences are mandatory: export (national authority) and import (destination authority). UN Conventions 1961 and 1971.
warnings.med008: EU: Biocidal Products Regulation (BPR) 528/2012, product registration required.
warnings.cos001: ADR class 3 above 24% alcohol. China: NMPA registration required, a lengthy procedure.
warnings.cos002: China: special products such as those with SPF need full NMPA registration, which can take two years.
warnings.cos004: Phenylenediamine (PPD) is regulated in the EU. Some substances are banned.
warnings.cos005: ADR class 3 (flammable). UN1210. Air freight restrictions apply.
warnings.cos006: Aerosols: ADR class 2 (UN1950). Air freight restrictions apply.
warnings.cos007: China: UV filters count as special cosmetics and need full NMPA registration. Australia: TGA.
warnings.cos008: Fluoride content is regulated in many countries. Check the limits.
warnings.cos009: Safety limits are stricter than for adults: no SLS, no parabens and similar.
warnings.tx003: USA: CPSC flammability standards for children's clothing. Check UFLPA for Xinjiang cotton.
warnings.tx006: Feather and down: an RDS (Responsible Down Standard) certificate is increasingly required.
warnings.tx008: Exotic leather (crocodile, snake, ostrich) needs a CITES permit.
warnings.tx009: USA: UFLPA presumes forced labour for cotton from Xinjiang, China.
warnings.veh001: USA: NHTSA Form HS-7 plus EPA 3520-1. Japan: its own type approval. AU: ADR compliance.
warnings.veh002: Most countries limit vehicle age. Japan and Australia drive on the right hand side.
warnings.veh003: The battery pack is a large lithium load with specific transport rules. State of charge 20 to 30%.
warnings.veh006: Combines are often out of gauge and need a road transport permit.
warnings.veh007: Air freight: the fuel tank must be drained and purged.
warnings.veh010: EU: tyre label (fuel efficiency, braking, noise). Check anti-dumping duties on tyres from China.
warnings.veh011: EN 15194 is the European standard for electric bicycles.
warnings.veh012: ADR class 8 (corrosive) plus class 9. Sulphuric acid. Many countries charge a recycling deposit.
warnings.met001: Check anti-dumping duties on steel from China and Russia in the EU and USA.
warnings.met005: LME grade, a London Metal Exchange recognition certificate is required.
warnings.met006: LME Grade A copper, certificate required.
warnings.met007: Basel Convention: exporting waste to developing countries needs a permit. Radioactivity freedom certificate required.
warnings.met008: Moisture is critical. Wet ore can liquefy inside the container.
warnings.met009: Self heating risk on long voyages. A self heating declaration is required.
warnings.wd001: FLEGT (legal harvesting). Rosewood and mahogany: CITES. Australia and USA: fumigation.
warnings.wd002: ISPM15 for wooden packaging. Lacey Act (USA), species and country declaration.
warnings.wd003: USA: TSCA Title VI formaldehyde emission certificate is mandatory.
warnings.wd004: USA: EPA TSCA Title VI. Japan: formaldehyde emission standard F four star.
warnings.wd006: Check the timber species against CITES (rosewood, mahogany, teak).
warnings.wd007: ISPM 15 is mandatory for export to the USA, AU, CN, JP and others. IPPC mark on every pallet.
warnings.wd008: EU: RED II directive requires a sustainability certificate for biomass.
warnings.mdc001: CE class I, the manufacturer can self assess conformity without a notified body.
warnings.mdc002: A notified body is required. FDA 510(k) for the USA. TGA for Australia.
warnings.mdc003: The strictest requirements. FDA Pre-Market Approval. Sterility is absolutely critical.
warnings.mdc004: Medical gas: purity certificate. ADR/IMDG class 2 for oxygen cylinders.
warnings.mdc008: IVD tests: the new IVDR 2017/746 applies in the EU. FDA EUA or 510(k).
warnings.en001: Check sanctions (Russia, Iran, Venezuela). A tanker is required. MARPOL compliance.
warnings.en002: Excise duty applies in most countries. UN1202, ADR class 3.
warnings.en003: UN1203, ADR class 3. The highest flammability rating.
warnings.en004: UN1075, ADR class 2. Special pressure tanks.
warnings.en005: Self heating risk. Check sanctions on coal from Russia.
warnings.en006: Check UFLPA for silicon from Xinjiang. Anti-dumping duties on panels from China in the EU and USA.
warnings.con001: Cement is corrosive to skin and eyes. An MSDS is required.
warnings.con002: Granite: check radioactivity (radon). Some batches from China exceed EU limits.
warnings.con003: Special transport on A-frames. Extremely fragile.
warnings.con006: An asbestos freedom certificate is required. Mineral wool carries a respirable fibre risk, so an MSDS is needed.
warnings.lux001: The customs value must be exact. Under-declaring is a customs offence. Insurance and escort are recommended.
warnings.lux003: A Kimberley Process Certificate is MANDATORY. Without it, import is banned in most countries.
warnings.lux004: A GIA, IGI or HRD certificate is required for stones above 0.5 ct. The value must be exact.
warnings.lux005: UK: hallmarking at an Assay Office is mandatory. CITES applies if it contains ivory, coral and similar.
warnings.lux007: A cultural goods export permit is required. UNESCO Convention 1970, provenance needed.
warnings.lux008: A ministry permit is mandatory for antiques above a set value.
warnings.lux009: CITES Appendix I or II. A national permit is required. Without CITES the goods are seized and fined.
warnings.lux010: USA: Fur Products Labeling Act. Check CITES for protected species. EU: fur imports from some countries are restricted.
warnings.lux011: Rosewood (Dalbergia spp.): CITES Appendix II. This covers guitar and violin fingerboards.
warnings.def001: Arms Trade Treaty (ATT). A national export licence is required. Check UN, EU and US embargoes.
warnings.def002: ADR class 1 (explosives). Two permits required. UN embargoes apply.
warnings.def003: ECCN 5E002 (USA) or ML21 (EU). An export licence is required for most countries. The code covers the physical medium (disc or drive). Software downloaded electronically has a different customs status.
warnings.def004: Dual-use category 6 (EU Regulation 2021/821). Classifying a specific device needs confirmation from a customs specialist, this is not a code to pick by eye. Export to embargoed countries is banned.
warnings.def006: Dual-use category 6 (EU Regulation 2021/821). Classifying a specific device needs confirmation from a customs specialist, this is not a code to pick by eye. Export to embargoed countries is banned.
warnings.def005: Chemical Weapons Convention (CWC). Export for military purposes is BANNED worldwide.

hints.PLT: EUR pallet: 120x80 cm, up to about 1,000 kg (industrial pallet 120x100 cm, up to about 1,500 kg).
hints.CTN: Cardboard packaging, usually up to about 30 kg.
hints.CRT: Wooden or plastic crate for irregular or heavier goods.
hints.BAG: Loose sack: big bag up to about 1,000 kg, or a plastic or paper sack.
hints.DRM: Metal or plastic drum, usually 200 l, mostly liquids and chemicals.
hints.ROL: Goods wound on a roll: film, fabric, paper, steel coil.
hints.PCS: A single unpacked unit of goods.
hints.SET: Several items packed and counted together.
hints.ULD: Unit Load Device, a standardised air container or pallet (for example AKE, AKH).
hints.LOOSE: Cargo without individual packaging, carried loose in the hold.
hints.TNK: Bulk liquids or gases: road or rail tanker, or an ISO tank container.
hints.BULK: Dry bulk goods without individual packaging, for example grain, aggregate, coal.
hints.RORO: Self propelled cargo unit (vehicle, trailer) driven onto the ferry or vessel.
